# Cowork Protocol

> A collaboration contract on top of WebMCP: bounded attention, offers that stay inert until a real human click, verified receipts, explicit presence and roles, scoped leases and grants, latest-only readback. Provider-neutral, dependency-light JavaScript (Node 22+), MIT.

Cowork Protocol is the submission to The WebMCP Challenge (2026). Two things carry it: a bridge, which has a place between one page and one model and is where the human clicks, and a vehicle, which carries a model across that bridge. The FormBuilder Studio page builds the bridge into itself; the browser extension carries the same bridge onto pages that built none; the Desktop Companion is the vehicle, not a third bridge. See docs/hosts.md before assuming any one of them is "the product".

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/cowork-protocol/blob/main/README.md): what it is, how to run everything, all npm scripts
- [Install with your AI assistant](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/cowork-protocol/blob/main/docs/install-with-your-assistant.md): a paste-ready prompt that installs and runs the repository step by step
- [Live showcase](https://ellmos-ai.github.io/cowork-protocol/apps/formbuilder-showcase/): FormBuilder Studio with the embedded Cowork panel (Chrome/Edge 150+ with WebMCP flags for native tool discovery)

- [Build a form with your agent](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/cowork-protocol/blob/main/docs/agent-guide.md): the nine tools in build order, what focus lets you offer, and the JSON value a field with answer choices needs
- [Work modes](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/cowork-protocol/blob/main/docs/work-modes.md): presence and role per actor decide the mode and who holds the click right
- [Integrating an existing app](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/cowork-protocol/blob/main/apps/formbuilder-showcase/INTEGRATION.md)
